name: Mister B and Flight to the Moon
description: In order to fly to the Moon Mister B just needs to solve the following problem. There is a complete indirected graph with n vertices. You need to cover it with several simple cycles of length 3 and 4 so that each edge is in exactly 2 cycles. We are sure that Mister B will solve the problem soon and will fly to the Moon. Will you?
input_specification: The only line contains single integer n ( 3 ≤ n ≤ 300 ).
output_specification: If there is no answer, print -1 . Otherwise, in the first line print k ( 1 ≤ k ≤ n 2 ) — the number of cycles in your solution. In each of the next k lines print description of one cycle in the following format: first print integer m ( 3 ≤ m ≤ 4 ) — the length of the cycle, then print m integers v 1 , v 2 , ..., v m ( 1 ≤ v i ≤ n ) — the vertices in the cycle in the traverse order. Each edge should be in exactly two cycles.
